description: This file contains Kotlin test code for the TasksRepository class, including a fake DAO implementation and multiple unit tests verifying repository behaviors such as insertion, update, deletion, and observing task list order.

classes.name: test_TasksRepository
classes.description: A test suite class containing unit tests for TasksRepository, including a fake DAO implementation used for in-memory testing.

methods.name: FakeTaskDao
methods.description: A private inner class that implements TaskDao with in-memory data storage for testing purposes.

methods.name: insert then getTask returns entity
methods.description: Test verifying that inserting a task and then retrieving it yields the correct entity data.

methods.name: update persists changes
methods.description: Test verifying that updating a task persists the changes.

methods.name: delete removes item
methods.description: Test verifying that deleting a task removes it from the repository.

methods.name: observeTasks emits ordered list incomplete first then updatedAt desc
methods.description: Test verifying that the observeTasks flow emits tasks ordered with incomplete tasks first, then by most recent updatedAt.
